# BD Bank Routing

> Bangladesh bank, branch and BEFTN routing-number data with per-bank provenance:
> 63 institutions, 11,426 branches, all
> 64 districts. Every row is traceable to the page it was read
> from and the date it was read. Dataset generated 2026-09-06.

A Bangladeshi routing number is nine digits: bank(3) + district(2) + branch(3) + check(1).
The first three digits ARE the bank and digits 4-5 ARE the district, so a routing number can
be checked against the bank name stored beside it rather than trusted.

## Core

- [Lookup tool and dataset overview](https://mdhrshohel.github.io/bd-bank-routing/): resolve a routing number, browse all banks
- [Source repository](https://github.com/MdHRShohel/bd-bank-routing): captures, build, packages, known gaps
- [Known gaps](https://github.com/MdHRShohel/bd-bank-routing/blob/main/docs/KNOWN-GAPS.md): what is deliberately missing, and why
- [Capture rules](https://github.com/MdHRShohel/bd-bank-routing/blob/main/docs/CAPTURING.md): how to read a bank's site without getting it wrong

## Packages

- `pip install bd-bank-routing` (imports as `bdbanks`)
- `npm install bd-bank-routing`
